info.title: OpenCanvas headless API
info.description: Read and change OpenCanvas canvases from programs (docs/27 §4, ADR-041). The host owns files and ACL; changes land in the live room and are saved to the host like any edit. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Turn it on per host with [host.flags] api_v1 = true.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Change events (SSE or WebSocket) and the headless CRDT sync ticket (HAPI-05)

tags.name: search
tags.description: Search across canvases through the host (ADR-065); OpenCanvas keeps no index

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the API is not enabled for this host ([host.flags] api_v1)
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The host has turned the API off (`[host.flags] api_v1 = false` in its entry of the hosts file).

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: missing or wrong credentials
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: No credentials, an unknown host, or a wrong host key. The answer carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="opencanvas"`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: token lifetime exceeds 15 minutes
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A bearer token failed a check: signature, issuer, audience, a lifetime over 15 minutes, or not yet valid (`nbf`). Also answered when the host has no public base URL, so user tokens are off for it.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the token has expired
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The bearer token's `exp` has passed. Mint a new one; tokens live at most 15 minutes.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: SCOPE_REQUIRED: comment_add needs canvas:comment
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The token's scope does not cover the operation. Admin operations need `canvas:admin`, which counts only when the host sets `[host.api] token_admin = true`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: ROLE_FORBIDDEN: no access to this file
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The user's role on the file is below what the operation needs (the effective permission is `min(scope, role)`), the token does not list the file in `files`, or the host revoked the user.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: FILES_REQUIRED: the host has no /access callback, so the token must list the files it covers in a `files` claim (or the host allows all files)
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The host does not implement `POST /access`, so a token's `role` claim counts only for the files in its `files` claim, and this token has none. Add `files`, implement `/access`, or set `[host.api] all_files = true`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: too many requests (subject limit); retry later
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A token bucket is empty: the caller's, or the file's write bucket. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds. The `RateLimit` header says which bucket and when it refills.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the idempotency store is unavailable; retry
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A dependency is briefly unavailable: the idempotency store, the node that runs the file's live room, or the ticket store. Retry after `Retry-After`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: internal error
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: An unexpected server error, or the host's `POST /access` callback failed. The server logs the cause; retrying may help.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: rows[0].values must be an object
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The request is not what the operation takes: the body is not a JSON object, a field is missing or has the wrong type, an op, mode, format or event type is unknown, or `fileId` is longer than 1,024 bytes. `detail` says which.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the cursor is not valid for this request
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The cursor is not one this server signed for this file and query: changed, truncated, from another host, or sent with a different `filter`, `sort` or `fields`. Pass `next_cursor` back unchanged.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the cursor has expired; start again without one
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Cursors last an hour. Start the walk again without one.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: Idempotency-Key must be 1-255 visible ASCII characters
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is empty, longer than 255 bytes, or has characters outside visible ASCII.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: this Idempotency-Key was used with a different request
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The key was used in the last 24 hours with another method, path or body. Use a new key for a new request.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still running
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A request with the same key is still running, on this or another node. Retry after `Retry-After` (1 second) to get its answer.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the request body is too large
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The request body is over the server's limit (at least 5 MiB, the import limit).

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: no block with that blockId
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: No block in the canvas has that `blockId` (the path's, an op's `blockId`, or a comment's `blockId`).

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: no database "db_01m87jv4sc2twxjhzzxzh7mene"
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: An unknown database, board or comment thread id, or a path that is no API operation.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: no database with that id
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The canvas has no database with that `dbId`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: a block changed since it was read; re-read it and retry
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A block op's `ifMatch` or the `If-Match` header names a revision that is no longer current. `fresh` carries the current state: the changed blocks with their `rev` and Markdown, or the document `rev`. Nothing was applied.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: Delete 6 blocks? Repeat the call with "confirm": true.
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The batch deletes more than 5 blocks. Send it again with `"confirm": true`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the file changed elsewhere; the host's conflict policy is running
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Your save callback answered that the file changed outside OpenCanvas; the host's conflict policy runs and the save is not retried.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: formats: md, html, json, ocanvas, docx, pdf
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Export (404): the format in the path is not one of `md`, `html`, `json`, `ocanvas`, `docx`, `pdf`. Convert (400): `from` or `to` is not supported.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: this host does not allow that format
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The host's export settings do not allow this format.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: PDF export needs OC_PDF_RENDERER=gotenberg:<url>; use the print view instead
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: PDF needs the operator to run the Gotenberg sidecar and set `OC_PDF_RENDERER`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: host answered 503 Service Unavailable
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Your load or save callback failed or timed out, so the file could not be loaded or saved.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: this host does not allow md import
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The format is not in the host's `[host.flags] import_formats`, or the operator set `OC_IMPORT=off`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the file must be UTF-8 text
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The file could not be read: not UTF-8, a malformed CSV, or a diagram that is unreadable, too deep or declares entities.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: at most 200 columns
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The file is over 5 MiB, or a CSV has more than 10,000 rows or 200 columns.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the patched document would exceed the size limit
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The change would make the canvas larger than the server's document limit.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the change could not be stored; retry
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The change could not be stored in the live room. Retry.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: not a valid .ocanvas zip: invalid Zip archive: Could not find EOCD
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Convert: the body is not a readable `.ocanvas` file.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: role must be view, comment, edit or none
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: `role` is not `view`, `comment`, `edit` or `none`.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: at most 100 event streams per file on one server
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A server holds at most 100 event streams per file. Close one, or share one stream between your workers.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: Method Not Allowed
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The path exists but not with this method; `Allow` lists the methods it takes.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: Unsupported Media Type
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A fallback for a request the router could not read.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: Unauthorized
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A fallback for a 401 that did not carry its own code.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: export not permitted for this session
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: A fallback for a 403 that did not carry its own code.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: error
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Any other error status without its own code.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: missing or wrong X-OpenCanvas-Host / X-OpenCanvas-Key
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: 0.1 routes: the host id or key is missing or wrong.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: op 1: blockId is required
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: 0.1 `patch`: an op is malformed.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: search needs a user token; a host key cannot search as everyone
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Search runs as a person, so the host's permissions apply; a host key has no person.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the host has no search callback ([host.search] callback)
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The host has not turned on `[host.search] callback`, or its `GET /search` answered 404, 405 or 501.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the host did not answer the search in time
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The host's search callback took longer than `[host.search] timeout_ms` (default 8 s).

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the host answered 500 Internal Server Error
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The host's search callback failed or answered something that is not a search answer.

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the body is not a .ocanvas file
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: The extract body is not a readable `.ocanvas` (or not UTF-8 Markdown).

x-opencanvas-error-codes.detail: the file took longer than 2 s to read
x-opencanvas-error-codes.description: Extraction has a 2 s budget per file.

get.description:
The canvas as JSON blocks (default), Markdown or a heading outline. Every block carries its `blockId` and a `rev` hash; the document `rev` comes back as `ETag`. Pass a block's `rev` as `ifMatch`, or the document's as `If-Match`, when you change it.

If nobody has the file open, OpenCanvas loads it from your load callback first.

post.summary: Change blocks in one atomic transaction

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The document rev (ETag) the batch expects; a mismatch answers 412 STALE_BLOCK.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true when this is the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key

RateLimit-Policy.description: Token buckets that apply: "subject";q=<burst>;w=<seconds to refill>, and "file-writes" on writes

RateLimit.description: The bucket closest to empty: "<name>";r=<remaining>;t=<seconds until full>

post.description:
Change blocks in one Yjs transaction: all ops apply, or none. Ops: `append` and `insertAfter` (with `markdown` or Tiptap `blocks`), `replace`, `delete`, and `editText` (`textEdits: [{find, replace}]`). An op with `ifMatch` whose block changed since you read it answers `412 STALE_BLOCK` with the fresh block, and the `If-Match` header does the same for the whole document. Deleting more than 5 blocks needs `"confirm": true`.

New content lands directly. Changes to existing blocks land directly too, unless the call sends `"mode": "suggest"` or the host sets `[host.api] default_mode = "suggest"`: then they become a suggestion (`suggestionId`) for a person to accept. The answer's `rev` is the new document revision (also the `ETag`).

post.description: Add a file's content to the canvas, after `blockId` or at the end, as one change. Send the file as the raw body (UTF-8, at most 5 MiB). Markdown and HTML become blocks (HTML keeps only safe links and images, never scripts or styles); CSV becomes one database block (the first column is the title; the others are typed number, date, checkbox, select or text, or by `types`), at most 10,000 rows and 200 columns. The format must be in the host's `[host.flags] import_formats`. The import path also takes diagrams (`format=drawio` or `excalidraw`, with `dryRun`, `page` and `boardId`) as described in the integration guide. If nobody had the file open, the answer carries the saved `version`.

get.summary: Change events of one file, as Server-Sent Events or (with a WebSocket upgrade) JSON text messages
get.description: SSE: `id: <event id>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <Event JSON>`, a keep-alive comment every 15 s. WebSocket: one Event per text message. Resume with `Last-Event-ID` (or `since`): the events after it from this server's in-memory ring (512 per file), or one `resync` event when it is gone. A stream that falls 256 events behind is closed with code 4008 (SSE: a final `close` event `{code, reason}`); a user token's stream closes with 4001 when the token expires, and with 4003 when the host revokes the user. Events carry ids only, never content.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types to receive (default all)

post.description: Convert a file without a canvas: `from` Markdown, HTML or `.ocanvas`, `to` `ocanvas`, `md`, `html`, `json`, `docx` or `pdf`. Send the file as the raw body; the answer is the converted file. Changes nothing, so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`. Images in DOCX and PDF come only from your `callback_base` or `asset_origins`; boards become pictures.

The `search.json` of a `.ocanvas` (or Markdown) body: the same plain-text projection every save carries, for hosts that cannot open the zip or want to re-index old files. Stateless: nothing is stored. Up to 100 MB and 2 s; comments only with `[host.search] comments = true`. Changes nothing, so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`.

get.description: Searches the canvases the token's user can open, through the host's own `GET /search` callback (the host indexes `search.json`; OpenCanvas keeps no index and caches nothing). Needs a **user** token: a host key gets 400 `USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED`. Hits on files the host's `/access` refuses are dropped. At most 10 searches a minute per user. The MCP tool `canvas_search` answers the same items.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

hostKey.name: X-OpenCanvas-Key
hostKey.description: The host's api_key (server to server; full access to the host's files, canvas:admin included). Sent with X-OpenCanvas-Host. Optional X-OpenCanvas-Author names the user a change is attributed to.

bearer.description: A user-scoped token the host mints (docs/05 §7b): iss = host id or [host.api] issuer, aud = {[host.api] audience or OC_PUBLIC_URL}/api/v1, sub, scope, exp at most 15 min ahead, optional role and files. Effective permission = min(scope, host role).
